elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "PAID OR PAYABLE ... OVER THE 12 MONTH PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" — anchored to the event, not the claim

elements.element: Cap is the greater of the two limbs

elements.evidence: No exclusion language appears anywhere in the rendered clause; it addresses only the aggregate cap and Excluded Claims
"A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY ... OBLIGATIONS"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out: infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 IS NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION" — narrowed to Section 5 compensation and framed as an exclusion from the limitation rather than all payment obligations not being damages

elements.element: Mutual cap of 12 months' fees (no larger preferred-only floor)
elements.evidence: "THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE ... AND (B) USD 1,000,000" — exceeds the fallback 12-month fee threshold with a preferred-only amount

elements.element: Fallback carve-outs: indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "CONFIDENTIALITY ... INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT"

offending_extra_words: THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM
reasons: Preferred level incomplete: the clause contains no mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages, which is an express preferred requirement.
The fee limb is anchored to "THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" rather than the preferred "12 months preceding the claim"; use the exact claim anchor and lowercase fee basis.

The payment-obligation sentence is narrower than the position: it carves out only "COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5" from the limitation instead of stating that Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
Fallback is not independently satisfied because the cap is a greater-of including a preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor rather than a straight 12 months' fees cap; the two levels cannot be blended.

Minimality fails: the edit is a whole-clause rewrite (53 words expanded to 109; changed-character ratio 0.789), where a tighter operator/party edit plus a short carve-out insertion anchored to more unchanged text would suffice.
Unrelated commercial terms and surrounding sentences remain effective; the new Section 12 and Section 5 cross-references are consistent with the agreement's indemnity and compensation sections.
